'''New Cylimba''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] within a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Veron Route]], which connected it to [[Veron/Legends|Veron]]. It was an industrial world whose badlands were the location of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] base during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" /> The base and its crew would likely have been crushed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, had [[Rivoche Tarkin]] not provided the necessary intelligence to avoid the attack.<ref name="GATORW" />
